correctness.rationale: For all J,h,r>0, explicit X-state solves the entire Lindbladian exactly, with two strictly positive block determinants. The faithful stationary state and Lindblad carré-du-champ commutant argument prove sole fixed state in the full 16-real-dimensional space; X-state concurrence plus two exact squared-modulus inequalities yields C>0 iff h>J/2 and 0<r<2sqrt(4h²-J²). The companion code passed 442 assertions, including exact symbolic identities and an independently constructed numerical Liouvillian; finite tests are auxiliary.

evidence: Kulkarni and Majumdar use r(|ψ0><ψ0|-ρ) as a full-system renewal reset to the same pure pair state; this is not r(|0><0|⊗tr1ρ-ρ), which retains the evolving second-qubit marginal.
Wald et al. use full-state resetting after discrete quantum gates, whose stationary state is a geometric mixture of unitary orbits and lacks the continuous local-replacement channel.

The closest published-finding corpus global-reset result with XX and bit-flip noises proves J²>ab and high-reset entanglement, whereas this model has no bit-flip bath and has only a finite low-reset entangled interval.

evidence: The earlier one-sided Ising work takes H=-J Z⊗Z+(Ω1 X⊗I+Ω2 I⊗X)/2 and erases qubit 1 into a Z-down eigenstate, proving separability. In our Hadamard-rotated Ising representation, H=J Z⊗Z+h(X⊗I+I⊗X), while the erased qubit is re-prepared in an X eigenstate; the reset-state orientation relative to Ising coupling is orthogonal, not equivalent.
In the present model the stationary partial transpose has a negative eigenvalue whenever 16h²>4J²+r², contradicting any claim that the two channels are conjugate.

originality.rationale: The closest complete one-sided Ising source resets qubit 1 along the Ising interaction, producing universal stationary separability. Here the local reset is perpendicular to that interaction and a strict entangled interval exists. Global-reset/whole-system papers have different quantum channels, even if the Hamiltonian resembles ours. Actual published-finding corpus queries, accessible own historical claims and primary-paper material show no dominating same-channel theorem; this is a qualified best-knowledge finding and independent publication priority remains open.

value.rationale: A natural change in local reset preparation orientation turns a previously known always-separable one-sided Ising setup into an entangling channel, with a complete nontrivial two-parameter sharp boundary h=J/2 and r_c=2sqrt(4h²-J²). The result quantifies the interplay of Hamiltonian field, coupling and selective-reset decoherence and is not simply a normalization or a substitution into the previously published separable-channel statement.
